query: A worker received a dose above the ordinary § 20.1201 annual limit during a planned special exposure that satisfied all seven conditions in § 20.1206(a)-(g). Does exceeding the ordinary annual limit itself require a § 20.2203 overexposure report, and what reporting duty still applies?
why: Tests the multi-hop exception and reporting chain: a valid planned special exposure is excepted from the ordinary § 20.1201 limits for the § 20.2203 overexposure determination, while § 20.2204 still requires its own 30-day report.
